producer.name: Microsoft Publisher
producer.appearance: Explicit frame fonts, margins and object colors; untouched native publication defaults.

observed: Three pages: first rectangle/picture/text/rectangle, empty middle, last text/picture/rectangle/picture. Shapes overlap so their order changes native paint. Three placements share one PNG. Wrapping is explicitly disabled on all eight shapes to match public authoring.
limits: Independent native authoring reference; managed/native text metrics, generic model serialization and repair-free opening are separate criteria.
